title: Jar Jar Binks
description: A Gungan from Naboo, Jar Jar Binks had been exiled by his people for his clumsiness. He introduced Qui-Gon Jinn and Obi-Wan Kenobi to Gungan leader Boss Nass after the Jedi saved his life. Jar Jar accompanied his new friends to Coruscant and Tatooine, before helping Queen Padmé Amidala secure an alliance with the Gungans. Jar Jar joined the Gungans for their fight against the Droid Army
